description: Reviews guest users and reports those that have been inactive for a specified period.
category: Compliance
icon: account-multiple-outline
version: 0.1.0
minAppVersion: 0.1.0
manifestVersion: 1

triggers:
  - id: manual
    type: manual
    label: Run Dormant Guest Accounts Report

steps:
  - id: load_guest_users
    name: Load guest users
    type: microsoft.graph.users.list
    settings:
      filter: "userType eq 'Guest'"
      select: "id,displayName,userPrincipalName,createdDateTime,lastSignInDateTime"
      top: 999

  - id: identify_dormant
    name: Identify dormant accounts
    type: function
    settings:
      function: filter
      args:
        array: "{{ load_guest_users.output }}"
        condition: "{{ item.lastSignInDateTime | default(item.createdDateTime) | date('YYYY-MM-DD') < (now() | date('YYYY-MM-DD') | subtract_days(365)) }}"

  - id: summarize
    name: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    type: llm
    settings:
      model: gpt-4o-mini
      temperature: 0.2
      system: >-
        You review guest accounts for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total guest accounts: {{ load_guest_users.output | size }}. Dormant accounts: {{ identify_dormant.output | size }}.
        Details: {{ identify_dormant.output | map('tojson') | join(', ') }}. Provide a short report: main finding, number of
        dormant accounts, and a single recommendation.

  - id: output
    name: Show report
    type: respond
    settings:
      text: "{{ summarize.output }}"
